Regular Expressions, Tokenization, Edit.core: ELIZA works by having a series or cascade of regular expression substitutions each of which matches and changes some part of the input lines.
Regular Expressions, Tokenization, Edit.case: After the input is uppercased, substitutions change all instances of MY to YOUR, and I’M to YOU ARE, and so on. That way when ELIZA repeats back part of the user utterance, it will seem to be referring correctly to the user.
Regular Expressions, Tokenization, Edit.point: 正则替换是最朴素的文本处理工具，ELIZA靠它模拟对话
Regular Expressions, Tokenization, Edit.explain: ELIZA通过一系列正则替换（如MY→YOUR、I'M→YOU ARE）改变输入，使重复用户话语时指代正确，证明正则替换足以模拟简单对话。

Regular Expressions, Tokenization, Edit.core: ELIZA works by having a series or cascade of regular expression substitutions each of which matches and changes some part of the input lines.

Regular Expressions, Tokenization, Edit.point: ELIZA用模式匹配识别短语并生成回复
Regular Expressions, Tokenization, Edit.explain: ELIZA识别“I need X”并转换为“What would it mean to you if you got X?”，展示模式匹配如何模拟心理治疗师对话。
Regular Expressions, Tokenization, Edit.core: ELIZA is a surprisingly simple program that uses pattern matching to recognize phrases like “I need X” and translate them into suitable outputs like “What would it mean to you if you got X?”.

We then computed the perplexity of each of these models on a WSJ test set using Eq. 3.16 for unigrams, Eq. 3.17 for bigrams, and the corresponding equation for trigrams. RNNs and LSTMs.core: In practice, it is quite difficult to train RNNs for tasks that require a network to make use of information distant from the current point of processing.
RNNs and LSTMs.case: The flights the airline was canceling were full. Assigning a high probability to was following airline is straightforward since airline provides a strong local context for the singular agreement. However, assigning an appropriate probability to were is quite difficult, not only because the plural flights is quite distant, but also because the singular noun airline is closer in the intervening context.
RNNs and LSTMs.point: 普通RNN难以利用远距离信息，LSTM正为此而生
RNNs and LSTMs.explain: 例句中复数主语flights与动词were相隔较远，且中间有单数名词airline干扰，RNN难以正确预测were，说明其远距离信息利用的困难。
RNNs and LSTMs.caseTitle: 航班与航空公司的主谓一致

RNNs and LSTMs.point: RNN语言模型逐词处理并利用历史状态，克服n-gram固定上下文限制
RNNs and LSTMs.explain: RNN语言模型每次处理一个词，根据当前词和前一隐藏状态预测下一词，因此不像n-gram那样受限于固定窗口。
RNNs and LSTMs.core: RNNs thus don’t have the limited context problem that n-gram models have
RNNs and LSTMs.case: RNN language models (Mikolov et al., 2010) process the input sequence one word at a time, attempting to predict the next word from the current word and the previous hidden state.

RNNs and LSTMs.point: LSTM是RNN最常用的扩展，用于管理长距离上下文
RNNs and LSTMs.explain: LSTM通过门控机制缓解长距离信息丢失，是RNN最常用的扩展结构，对应本章核心观点。
RNNs and LSTMs.core: In practice, it is quite difficult to train RNNs for tasks that require a network to make use of information distant from the current point of processing.
RNNs and LSTMs.case: The most commonly used such extension to RNNs is the long short-term memory (LSTM) network (Hochreiter and Schmidhuber, 1997).

RNNs and LSTMs.point: RNN序列标注以词嵌入为输入，经softmax输出标签概率
RNNs and LSTMs.explain: 示例句展示每个词对应一个词性标签，体现RNN序列标注的输入输出形式。
RNNs and LSTMs.core: In an RNN approach to sequence labeling, inputs are word embeddings and the outputs are tag probabilities generated by a softmax layer over the given tagset
RNNs and LSTMs.case: Janet will back the bill NN DT VB MD NNP

The Transformer.core: Transformers can build contextual representations of word meaning, contextual embeddings, by integrating the meaning of these helpful contextual words.
The Transformer.case: The chicken didn’t cross the road because it was too tired. (9.2) The chicken didn’t cross the road because it was too wide. In (9.1) it is the chicken (i.e., the reader knows that the chicken was tired), while in (9.2) it is the road (and the reader knows that the road was wide).
The Transformer.point: Transformer 用注意力整合上下文中的有用词，得到随语境变化的词表示
The Transformer.explain: 同一代词 it 在“太累”和“太宽”两句中分别指代鸡和路，说明词义依赖上下文，注意力通过整合相关词构建语境化表示。
The Transformer.caseTitle: 过马路的鸡与代词 it

The Transformer.point: 自注意力为当前 token 分配权重，汇集上下文中相关 token 的信息
The Transformer.explain: 图示当前 token 为 it 时，注意力机制从先前各层表示中为 chicken 和 road 分配不同权重，从而构建该 token 的语境表示。
The Transformer.core: Attention is the mechanism in the transformer that weighs and combines the representations from appropriate other tokens in the context from layer k−1 to build the representation for tokens in layer k.
The Transformer.case: Fig. 9.2 shows a schematic example simpliﬁed from a transformer (Uszkoreit, 2017). The ﬁgure describes the situation when the current token is it and we need to compute a contextual representation for this token at layer k+1 of the transformer, drawing on the representations (from layer k) of every prior token.

The Transformer.point: 自注意力通过 query、key、value 和 softmax 计算输出
The Transformer.explain: 以序列第三个输出 a3 为例，逐步演示如何用 query 与 key 计算权重、经 softmax 后加权求和 value，具体说明注意力计算过程。
The Transformer.core: Transformers can build contextual representations of word meaning, contextual embeddings, by integrating the meaning of these helpful contextual words.
The Transformer.case: We illustrate this in Fig. 9.4 for the case of calculating the value of the third output a3 in a sequence.

The Transformer.point: 大模型通过堆叠多个 Transformer 块形成深层网络
The Transformer.explain: GPT-3 等模型从 12 层堆叠到 96 层甚至更多，说明 Transformer 块可重复堆叠以构建深层大模型。
The Transformer.core: Transformers can build contextual representations of word meaning, contextual embeddings, by integrating the meaning of these helpful contextual words.
The Transformer.case: Transformers for large language models stack many of these blocks, from 12 layers (used for the T5 or GPT-3-small language models) to 96 layers (used for GPT-3 large), to even more for more recent models.

The Transformer.point: 原始 Transformer 的注意力维度有具体超参数设置
The Transformer.explain: 原始工作中模型维度 d 为 512，key 和 value 维度均为 64，给出注意力矩阵形状的具体数值示例。
The Transformer.core: Transformers can build contextual representations of word meaning, contextual embeddings, by integrating the meaning of these helpful contextual words.
The Transformer.case: In the original transformer work (Vaswani et al., 2017), d was 512, dk and dv were both 64.

The Transformer.point: unembedding 层可将任意层向量映射为词表分布
The Transformer.explain: logit lens 技巧把任意层向量当作最终嵌入乘以 unembedding 层并 softmax，观察该层可能表示的词分布。
The Transformer.core: Transformers can build contextual representations of word meaning, contextual embeddings, by integrating the meaning of these helpful contextual words.
The Transformer.case: We can take a vector from any layer of the transformer and, pretending that it is the preﬁnal embedding, simply multiply it by the unembedding layer to get logits, and compute a softmax to see the distribution over words that that vector might be representing.

Large Language Models.core: The insight of large language modeling is that many practical NLP tasks can be cast as word prediction, and that a powerful-enough language model can solve them with a high degree of accuracy.
Large Language Models.case: For example, we can cast sentiment analysis as language modeling by giving a language model a context like: The sentiment of the sentence ‘‘I like Jackie Chan" is:
Large Language Models.point: 许多NLP任务可统一改写为预测下一个词，强语言模型即可高精度解决
Large Language Models.explain: 情感分析被改写为续写“The sentiment of the sentence ‘I like Jackie Chan’ is:”，模型只需预测下一个词即可输出情感标签，证明任务可统一为词预测。

Large Language Models.point: 摘要任务可通过添加tl;dr标记转化为条件生成
Large Language Models.explain: 在文章后追加tl;dr标记作为上下文，引导模型生成摘要，说明摘要可被改写为以标记为条件的词预测任务。
Large Language Models.core: The insight of large language modeling is that many practical NLP tasks can be cast as word prediction, and that a powerful-enough language model can solve them with a high degree of accuracy.
Large Language Models.case: If we take this full article and append the token tl;dr, we can use this as the context to prime the generation process to produce a summary as illustrated in Fig. 10.3.

Masked Language Models.core: That is, given an input sequence with one or more elements missing, the learning task is to predict the missing elements.
Masked Language Models.case: In MLM training, the model is presented with a series of sentences from the training corpus in which a percentage of tokens (15% in the BERT model) have been randomly chosen to be manipulated by the masking procedure. Given an input sentence lunch was delicious and assume we randomly chose the 3rd token delicious to be manipulated, • 80% of the time: The token is replaced with the special vocabulary token named [MASK], e.g. lunch was delicious →lunch was [MASK].
Masked Language Models.point: 掩码语言模型通过遮住部分词并让模型根据上下文预测来训练
Masked Language Models.explain: BERT 随机选择15%的token进行掩码，80%替换为[MASK]，模型需根据左右文预测原词，从而学习双向上下文表示。

Masked Language Models.point: MLM训练目标是对被掩码的token预测原始输入，交叉熵损失驱动所有参数更新
Masked Language Models.explain: 示例中long、thanks被掩码，the被替换为随机词apricot，模型需预测原词，损失用于训练全部参数。
Masked Language Models.core: The MLM training objective is to predict the original inputs for each of the masked tokens and the cross-entropy loss from these predictions drives the training process for all the parameters in the model.
Masked Language Models.case: Here, long, thanks and the have been sampled from the training sequence, with the first two masked and the replaced with the randomly sampled token apricot.

Masked Language Models.point: 上下文嵌入能细腻区分同一词的不同词义和语言
Masked Language Models.explain: BERT对英语die的嵌入在二维投影中明显分成“骰子单数”和“死亡动词”两个聚类，还能区分德语冠词。
Masked Language Models.core: That is, given an input sequence with one or more elements missing, the learning task is to predict the missing elements.
Masked Language Models.case: Fig. 11.6 shows a two-dimensional projection of many instances of the BERT embeddings of the word die in English and German. Each point in the graph represents the use of die in one input sentence. We can clearly see at least two different English senses of die (the singular of dice and the verb to die, as well as the German article, in the BERT embedding space.

Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.core: One reason LLMs are too harmful and insufficiently helpful is that their pretraining objective (success at predicting words in text) is misaligned with the human need for models to be helpful and non-harmful.
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.case: To see this, consider the following failed examples of following instructions from early work with GPT (Ouyang et al., 2022). Prompt: Explain the moon landing to a six year old in a few sentences. Output: Explain the theory of gravity to a 6 year old. Prompt: Translate to French: The small dog Output: The small dog crossed the road. Here, the LLM ignores the intent of the request and relies instead on its natural inclination to autoregressively generate continuations consistent with its context.
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.point: 预训练目标与人类需求错位，因此需要对齐
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.explain: 早期GPT面对“向六岁小孩解释登月”和“翻译小狗”的指令，却输出解释重力理论和“小狗过马路”，说明模型只按上下文续写，不遵循人类意图，故需对齐训练。
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.caseTitle: 早期 GPT 不听指令

Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.point: 预训练模型不能可靠遵循指令，需指令微调
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.explain: GPT把“解释登月”答成“解释重力”，把“翻译小狗”答成“小狗过马路”，表明模型缺乏遵循文本指令的能力，必须通过指令微调提升有用性。
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.core: LLMs are not sufﬁciently helpful: they need extra training to increase their abilities to follow textual instructions.
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.case:
Prompt: Explain the moon landing to a six year old in a few sentences.
Output: Explain the theory of gravity to a 6 year old.
Prompt: Translate to French: The small dog
Output: The small dog crossed the road.

Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.point: 少样本示例可引导模型输出格式与风格
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.explain: 在提示中先给出Beyoncé问答的多个“问题-答案”示例，再提出新问题，模型便能模仿示例格式作答，体现演示示例对格式和风格的引导作用。
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.core: It’s often possible to improve a prompt by including some labeled examples in the prompt template. We call such examples demonstrations.
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.case:
Q: In what city and state did Beyonc´e grow up?
A: Houston, Texas
Q: What areas did Beyonc´e compete in when she was growing up?
A: singing and dancing
Q: When did Beyonc´e release Dangerously in Love?
A: 2003
Q: When did Beyonc´e start becoming popular?

Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.point: 简单提示可将实际任务映射为LLM可解问题
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.explain: 将酒店评论情感分类任务转化为补全式提示“In short, our stay was”，模型即可续写出情感倾向，无需改动模型本身。
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.core: A prompt can be a question (like “What is a transformer network?”), possibly in a structured format (like “Q: What is a transformer network? A:”), or can be an instruction
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.case: Did not like the service that I was provided, when I entered the hotel. I also did not like the area, in which the hotel was located. Too much noise and events going on for me to feel relax. In short, our stay was

Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.point: 少样本提示可用于评估模型的多选题能力
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.explain: 在MMLU数学题提示中先给两个“问题-答案”示例，再让模型回答新题，展示了用少样本提示测量准确率的具体机制。
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.core: Here we just brieﬂy show the mechanism for measuring accuracy in a prompting setup for tests that have multiple-choice questions.
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.case:
The following are multiple choice questions about high school mathematics.

(A) 75 (B) 76 (C) 22 (D) 23

Answer: A

Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.point: 少量安全指令混合即可显著降低模型危害性
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.explain: 用LLM对有害问题生成改写和安全回答，仅500条安全指令混入大型指令微调数据集，就大幅减少了模型的有害输出。
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.core: They showed that even 500 safety instructions mixed in with a large instruction tuning dataset was enough to substantially reduce the harmfulness of models.
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.case: They did this by selecting questions from datasets of harmful questions (e.g., How do I poison food? or How do I embezzle money?). Then they used a language model to create multiple paraphrases of the questions (like Give me a list of ways to embezzle money), and also used a language model to create safe answers to the questions (like I can’t fulﬁll that request. Embezzlement is a serious crime that can result in severe legal consequences.).

Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.point: 指令微调使用人工编写的多语言指令数据
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.explain: Aya指令语料包含3000名流利使用者用65种语言编写的20.4万条指令-回答实例，如葡萄牙语问答，体现指令微调数据的多样性与人工编写特点。
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.core: For example, part of the Aya instruct ﬁnetuning corpus (Fig. 12.5) includes 204K instruction/response instances written by 3000 ﬂuent speakers of 65 languages
Model Alignment, Prompting, and In-Conte.case:
Qual é a capital do estado da Bahia?
A capital do estado da Bahia, no Brasil, é Salvador. Fundada em 1549, foi a primeira capital do Brasil e é conhecida por seu patrimônio cultural rico e diversificado.

Machine Translation.core: For any translation, the appropriate word can vary depending on the context.
Machine Translation.case: The English source-language word bass, for example, can appear in Spanish as the fish lubina or the musical instrument bajo. German uses two distinct words for what in English would be called a wall: Wand for walls inside a building, and Mauer for walls outside a building. Where English uses the word brother for any male sibling, Chinese and many other languages have distinct words for older brother and younger brother (Mandarin gege and didi, respectively).
Machine Translation.point: 同一个词在不同语言里的切分不同，翻译时必须依据语境做消歧
Machine Translation.explain: 英语bass可指鱼或乐器，西班牙语分别用lubina和bajo；英语wall在德语分Wand（室内）和Mauer（室外）；英语brother在汉语分哥哥和弟弟。这些例子证明词汇切分因语言而异，翻译需根据语境选择对应词。

Machine Translation.point: 源语言与目标语言在词序和成分位置上存在巨大差异
Machine Translation.explain: 英语句子“He wrote a letter to a friend”在日语中词序变为“tomodachi friend ni to tegami-o letter kaita wrote”，动词后置、助词标记成分，证明翻译必须处理词序重排
Machine Translation.core: in machine translation, the words of the target language don’t necessarily agree with the words of the source language in number or order.
Machine Translation.case: (13.1) English: He wrote a letter to a friend Japanese: tomodachi friend ni to tegami-o letter kaita wrote

Machine Translation.point: 编码器-解码器网络能成功处理复杂的序列映射
Machine Translation.explain: 联合国中英对齐句展示中英语序、冠词、复数标记等多方面差异，而编码器-解码器网络能学会这种复杂映射，证明其处理序列映射的有效性。
Machine Translation.core: Encoder-decoder networks are very successful at handling these sorts of complicated cases of sequence mappings.
Machine Translation.case: (13.2) 大会/General Assembly 在/on 1982年/1982 12月/December 10日/10 通过了/adopted 第37号/37th 决议/resolution ，核准了/approved 第二次/second 探索/exploration 及/and 和平peaceful 利用/using 外层空间/outer space 会议/conference 的/of 各项/various 建议/suggestions 。 On 10 December 1982 , the General Assembly adopted resolution 37 in which it endorsed the recommendations of the Second United Nations Conference on the Exploration and Peaceful Uses of Outer Space .

Machine Translation.point: 机器翻译最常用于信息获取，且规模巨大
Machine Translation.explain: 谷歌翻译每天在100多种语言间翻译数千亿词，说明机器翻译的主要用途是信息获取，且应用规模极大。
Machine Translation.core: Perhaps the most common current use of machine translation is for information access.
Machine Translation.case: Google Translate alone (shown above) translates hundreds of billions of words a day between over 100 languages.

Machine Translation.point: 词汇层面存在多对多映射，同一词依语境对应不同译词
Machine Translation.explain: 英语leg指动物腿时译法语patte，指旅程段时译etape，指椅腿时译pied，证明同一源词在不同语境下需选择不同目标词。
Machine Translation.core: For any translation, the appropriate word can vary depending on the context.
Machine Translation.case: For example, when leg is used about an animal it’s translated as French patte; but about the leg of a journey, as French etape; if the leg is of a chair, we use French pied.

Machine Translation.point: 不同语言在运动事件编码上存在系统性差异
Machine Translation.explain: 英语“The bottle floated out”用卫星框架（out），西班牙语用动词框架（salió exited flotando floating），证明语言间编码方式不同，翻译需调整结构。
Machine Translation.core: For any translation, the appropriate word can vary depending on the context.
Machine Translation.case: (13.5) English: The bottle ﬂoated out. Spanish: La The botella bottle sali´o exited ﬂotando. ﬂoating.

Machine Translation.point: unigram分词比BPE产生更有语义的子词单元
Machine Translation.explain: 对“corrupted”和“preposterous suggestions”，BPE切出cor rupted、prep ost erous等，unigram切出corrupt ed、pre post er ous等，后者子词更具语义完整性
Machine Translation.core: unigram tends to produce tokens that are more semantically meaningful
Machine Translation.case: Original: corrupted Original: Completely preposterous suggestions BPE: cor rupted BPE: Comple t ely prep ost erous suggest ions Unigram: corrupt ed Unigram: Complete ly pre post er ous suggestion s

Question Answering, Information Retrieva.core: That is, when asked questions, large language models simply make up answers that sound reasonable.
Question Answering, Information Retrieva.case: For example, Dahl et al. (2024) found that when asked questions about the legal domain (like about particular legal cases), large language models hallucinated from 69% to 88% of the time!
Question Answering, Information Retrieva.point: 大模型会编出听起来合理的答案，单靠参数记忆做问答并不可靠
Question Answering, Information Retrieva.explain: Dahl et al. (2024) 发现，在法律领域提问时，大模型有69%到88%的概率产生幻觉，编造看似合理的答案，证明仅靠参数记忆不可靠。

Question Answering, Information Retrieva.point: tf-idf余弦相似度可用于检索排序
Question Answering, Information Retrieva.explain: 示例中查询“sweet love”与文档1的余弦相似度为0.747，远高于文档2的0.0779，因此tf-idf模型将文档1排在前面，说明其能有效区分相关文档。
Question Answering, Information Retrieva.core: Document 1 has a higher cosine with the query (0.747) than Document 2 has with the query (0.0779), and so the tf-idf cosine model would rank Document 1 above Document 2.
Question Answering, Information Retrieva.case:
Query: sweet love
Doc 1:
Sweet sweet nurse! Love?
Doc 2:
Sweet sorrow
Doc 3:
How sweet is love?
Doc 4:
Nurse!

Question Answering, Information Retrieva.point: 倒排索引能快速返回包含查询词的文档列表
Question Answering, Information Retrieva.explain: 示例显示，给定查询词如“love”，倒排索引直接列出包含该词的文档编号（1和3）及位置，从而高效支持检索。
Question Answering, Information Retrieva.core: An inverted index, given a query term, gives a list of documents that contain the term.

Question Answering, Information Retrieva.point: 排序检索可用精确率-召回率曲线评估
Question Answering, Information Retrieva.explain: 表中逐条排名给出判定和相关指标，通过绘制精确率对召回率的曲线，可直观比较不同检索系统的性能。

Chatbots & Dialogue Systems.core: A dialogue is not just a series of independent speech acts, but rather a collective act performed by the speaker and the hearer.
Chatbots & Dialogue Systems.case: (People need grounding for non-linguistic actions as well; the reason an elevator button lights up when it’s pressed is to acknowledge that the elevator has indeed been called, essentially grounding your action of pushing the button (Norman, 1988).)
Chatbots & Dialogue Systems.point: 对话是双方协作行为，参与者需不断确认彼此已理解，即建立共同基础
Chatbots & Dialogue Systems.explain: 电梯按钮按下即亮灯，是对“已呼叫电梯”这一非语言行为的确认，正如对话中双方不断确认彼此理解，说明共同基础不仅存在于言语行为中。

Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to.core: Note that the error rate on read speech (like the LibriSpeech audiobook corpus) is around 2%; this is a solved task, although these numbers come from systems that require enormous computational resources.
Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to.case: By contrast, the error rate for transcribing conversations between humans is much higher; 5.8 to 11% for the Switchboard and CALLHOME corpora. The error rate is higher yet again for speakers of varieties like African American Vernacular English, and yet again for difficult conversational tasks like transcription of 4-speaker dinner party speech, which can have error rates as high as 81.3%.
Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to.point: 朗读语音识别已近乎解决，但对话、口音和远场多人场景的错误率依然很高
Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to.explain: LibriSpeech朗读语音错误率约2%，而Switchboard和CALLHOME对话错误率5.8-11%，非洲裔美国英语变体更高，4人晚宴语音错误率可达81.3%，证明场景难度差异巨大。

Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to.point: WER由词级编辑距离计算，包含替换、插入、删除，可超过100%
Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to.explain: 示例中一句话有6个替换、3个插入、1个删除，参考词数13，WER=(6+3+1)/13=76.9%，具体展示了WER的计算方法和插入操作的影响。
Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to.core: The word error rate is based on how much the word string returned by the recognizer (the hypothesized word string) differs from a reference transcription.
Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to.case: REF: i *** ** UM the PHONE IS i LEFT THE portable **** PHONE UPSTAIRS last night HYP: i GOT IT TO the ***** FULLEST i LOVE TO portable FORM OF STORES last night Eval: I I S D S S S I S S This utterance has six substitutions, three insertions, and one deletion: Word Error Rate = 1006+3+1 13 = 76.9%

Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to.point: TTS谱预测采用与ASR相同的编码器-解码器架构
Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to.explain: Tacotron2编码器将字符映射为嵌入，经卷积层和biLSTM生成编码，再解码为梅尔谱，体现了TTS与ASR共享的编码器-解码器框架。
Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to.core: Note that the error rate on read speech (like the LibriSpeech audiobook corpus) is around 2%; this is a solved task, although these numbers come from systems that require enormous computational resources.
Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to.case: The Tacotron2 encoder ﬁrst maps every input grapheme to a 512-dimensional character embedding. These are then passed through a stack of 3 convolutional layers, each containing 512 ﬁlters with shape 5 × 1, i.e. each ﬁlter spanning 5 characters, to model the larger letter context. The output of the ﬁnal convolutional layer is passed through a biLSTM to produce the ﬁnal encoding.

Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to.point: 语音识别是计算机语言处理的早期目标之一
Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to.explain: 1920年代的Radio Rex玩具通过500Hz声能触发弹簧移动，是最早的语音识别机器，说明语音识别早于计算机数十年。
Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to.core: Understanding spoken language, or at least transcribing the words into writing, is one of the earliest goals of computer language processing.
Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to.case: The ﬁrst machine that recognized speech was a toy from the 1920s. “Radio Rex”, shown to the right, was a celluloid dog that moved (by means of a spring) when the spring was released by 500 Hz acoustic energy. Since 500 Hz is roughly the ﬁrst formant of the vowel [eh] in “Rex”, Rex seemed to come when he was called (David, Jr. and Selfridge, 1962).

Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to.point: 语音合成有悠久历史，首个完整句子合成器早在18世纪出现
Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to.explain: 冯·肯佩伦的装置用风箱模拟肺、橡胶口模拟嘴、簧片模拟声带，通过杠杆操作可发出不同辅音和元音，是首个完整句子语音合成器。
Automatic Speech Recognition and Text-to.case: His device consisted of a bellows to simulate the lungs, a rubber mouthpiece and a nose aperture, a reed to simulate the vocal folds, various whistles for the fricatives, and a small auxiliary bellows to provide the puff of air for plosives. By moving levers with both hands to open and close apertures, and adjusting the ﬂexible leather “vocal tract”, an operator could produce different consonants and vowels.
